item.description: Travelers in the air and on the ground are bracing for bad weather later this week. In San Francisco, a powerful storm is expected to bring king tides and heavy flooding. In New York, there’s concern that rain and high winds could ground the Thanksgiving Day Parade balloons. Meanwhile, on this busy travel week, airlines have been managing a ground stop in Chicago and the residual effect from Delta’s computer outage this weekend. NBC News’ Tom Costello has the story.
